description: Current reading of the AI Layoffs Index, a 0-100 score of AI-attributed job-loss pressure scaled against AI's own history since 2023 (not a share of all jobs). Returns the value, its band, the uncertainty range, the change vs last month, the three weighted components with what each reads, the as-of date, and a ready-made citation string. Takes no arguments.
name: get_ai_layoffs_index
title: Get the AI Layoffs Index
